question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**parts**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**parts**'.
 
• In the given context it means 'one of the pieces, areas, periods, things, etc. that together with others forms the whole of something; some, but not all of something'. (अंश, भाग, खंड, हिस्‍सा)
 
 
• *Example: Which **part** of Gujarat do you come from?*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Answer:__ __Correct Passage:__ *How should one read a story to a child? Usually, a personality or character of the story catches the child’s interest the most. So, use different voices for each character or act out various **parts** from the story, to bring life to those characters. (5) ______ out parts from the story will make story sessions fun and memorable for the kids. *
